name: bf-corporate-tax
description: Burkina Faso corporate income tax reference for the 2026 tax year, covering ordinary IS scope, partnership elections, taxable-profit adjustments, the minimum tax, advance payments and the annual return. Use for questions about the 27.5 percent company tax, loss-making companies, the RNI or RSI minimum, CGA reductions, first-year exemptions, head-office fees, donations and distributions. The Guide separates statutory preparation requirements from unverified form boxes and portal actions. It supplies two recomputing cases, including the minimum-tax decision, and identifies the official 2026 CGI articles read. It does not complete specialist exemptions, permanent-establishment attribution, treaty relief or authenticated filing.
